'''Chapter 972''' is titled "Oden Wouldn't Be Oden If It Wasn't Boiled".{{Sort}}

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]] - The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] and their counterparts from the "[[Hungry Days]]" commercial series.

==Short Summary==
Shocked by what [[Shinobu]] revealed, the citizens change their behavior and start to cheer for [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]], but they discover that they are surrounded by [[Kurozumi Orochi|Orochi's]] men. Nearing the end of the [[Legendary Hour|set time]], the citizens count down and after an hour passed, Orochi summoned a firing squad to execute Oden and [[Nine Red Scabbards|his men]]. Oden throws his men away from the execution site and leaves them with his wish to open the borders of [[Wano Country|Wano]] to the world. As the Scabbards escape, Oden then dies when [[Kaidou]] shoots him.

Back in [[Kuri]], news arrive to [[Kouzuki Toki|Toki]] and she recalls Oden giving her [[Ame no Habakiri|his]] [[Enma|swords]] while in prison to pass them on to [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|their]] [[Kouzuki Hiyori|children]]. The letter he gave to her before he left told her to use [[Toki Toki no Mi|her power]] in preparation for a great war in 20 years time.

==Long Summary==
As the citizens are surprised by [[Shinobu]] revealing the truth behind [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden's]] actions, she is threatened by [[Fukurokuju]] and the [[Orochi Oniwabanshu]] for speaking against the [[Kurozumi Orochi|shogun]]. Shinobu confronts her former leader with the rise of the [[Kouzuki Family]], but he dismisses her words. Meanwhile, the citizens beg for Orochi to stop the execution, but they are shot with arrows in response.

The crowd then realizes both Orochi and Oden's actions, but discovers too late that they are surrounded by Orochi's men, as words about Oden's bravery spread out. Oden then talks to [[Nine Red Scabbards|his retainers]] about a figure from 800 years ago that [[Wano Country]] should be prepared to follow. He then states that he will die today, much to the distress of [[Kikunojo]], and reveals his wish to open Wano to the rest of the world.

News continued to spread throughout Wano, to its further regions, as the temperature of the boiling oil kept rising. The citizens cheered for Oden, encouraging him to withstand the [[Legendary Hour|torture]], and offering the apologies for their harsh words and their ignorance. Despite the situation and their past, Oden forgave and thanked them all, appreciating their support.

Oden then reveals his wish once more, now to the rest of Wano, revealing it was the Kouzuki who closed off Wano, in order to protect it from harm by an unknown force. He then continues to say that Wano and the entire world is waiting for a figure to come after an 800 years span. When that time comes, Wano, as Oden emphasizes, has to welcome and work with them. He then requests his scabbards to open Wano's border for this to happen. As [[Denjiro]] starts to comment, he is stopped by [[Raizo]], who speaks on behalf of the Scabbards, saying they would make Oden's dream their own.

As the hour was about to pass, and Oden remained standing, Orochi began to worry, and the clock and the citizens counted down as the hour was done. As the citizens and Scabbards celebrated, it was short-lived, as a firing squad assembled around the pot, and Orochi reveals that he changed the sentence a minute prior and prepares to kill the entire group. As a citizen tries to object and is shot down, Oden throws his men far away from the execution site, freeing them. [[Kin'emon]] tells his fellow Scabbards to run towards [[Kuri]]. Shinobu is also able to escape, and as the Scabbards reminisce about their savior under fire, [[Kaidou]] aims a gun at Oden, still in the boiling pot.

The pirate comments on Oden's heroism and apologizes about [[Kurozumi Higurashi|Higurashi's]] acts in their last fight, before revealing he had her killed. Oden commends him for his honor, and recites his name phrase "I am Oden, and I was born..." but is shot and his body sinks into the sizzling oil, leaving the sorrowful citizens to finish in his honor: "To boil!"

Back in Kuri, in Oden Castle, [[Banzaburo|a servant]] tells [[Kouzuki Toki]] the news and she reads a letter left to her by Oden before he left to face Kaidou. In the letter, Oden gives Toki instruction in case he fails to bring Kaidou down. He tells her that 20 years from then, a war is likely to break out and a power capable of bringing Kaidou down will come to the [[New World]], and he asks her to use her [[Toki Toki no Mi|abilities]]. Toki then remembers her visiting Oden while he was imprisoned. He gave her [[Ame no Habakiri|his]] [[Enma|swords]] to pass them on to [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|their]] [[Kouzuki Hiyori|children]]. Toki tears up the letter, and with tears in her eyes, she promises to follow Oden's words.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]] revealed that the reason the [[Kouzuki Family]] isolated [[Wano Country]] was to protect it from a great force.
*Oden explained the meaning of opening Wano Country's border and that is about welcoming a certain individual to Wano Country.
*Seeing Oden [[Legendary Hour|surviving the boiling pot]], [[Kurozumi Orochi|Orochi]] changed the sentence and ordered a firing squad.
**Oden managed to save the [[Nine Red Scabbards]] by throwing them away from the execution site, and they ran towards [[Kuri]].
**[[Kaidou]] revealed that he killed [[Kurozumi Higurashi]] prior to Oden's execution.
**Kaidou executed Oden with a pistol.
*While in prison, Oden handed [[Ame no Habakiri|his]] [[Enma|swords]] to [[Kouzuki Toki|Toki]].
*It is revealed that Oden was the one who came up with the plan for Toki to use her [[Toki Toki no Mi]] to travel 20 years into the future.
